description: This file implements a traversal and printing mechanism for an abstract syntax tree (AST) of shader code, including functions for visiting various node types and outputting their structure and details.

classes.name: TOutputTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an AST of shader code, outputting a textual representation of each node.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Outputs information about a symbol node, including its name, ID, and type.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Outputs information about a swizzle node, including its offsets and type.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Outputs information about a binary operation node, including the operation type and operands.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Outputs information about a unary operation node, including the operation and type.

methods.name: visitFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Outputs a marker indicating a function definition node.

methods.name: visitGlobalQualifierDeclaration
methods.description: Outputs a marker indicating a global qualifier declaration.

methods.name: visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Outputs a function prototype and its parameters.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Outputs information about an aggregate node, including the specific function or operation.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Outputs a marker indicating a code block.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Outputs a marker indicating a declaration.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Outputs a ternary conditional expression and its components.

methods.name: visitIfElse
methods.description: Outputs an if-else statement and its condition and branches.

methods.name: visitCase
methods.description: Outputs a case or default label.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Outputs the constant values contained in a union node.

methods.name: visitLoop
methods.description: Outputs information about a loop, including its condition and body.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Outputs branch instructions like break, continue, return, or kill.
